themes.name: Central banks and interest rates
themes.sectors: Banks, NBFCs, real estate, autos (loan-funded demand); foreign flows
themes.why: Rate decisions change borrowing costs and the return on bonds versus shares; foreign portfolio money reacts quickly.
q: ECB OR "Bank of Japan" interest rates

themes.name: Inflation, growth and jobs data
themes.sectors: The whole market; consumer and capital-goods companies most
themes.why: Economy-level numbers come first in the top-down (economy, industry, company) approach.

themes.name: Wars, conflicts and security
themes.sectors: Oil marketing and aviation (crude), defence, shipping and logistics, exporters
themes.why: Conflicts in oil regions lift crude and the risk premium; disruption of shipping routes hits supply chains.
q: Middle East Iran Israel tensions markets

themes.name: Trade, tariffs and sanctions
themes.sectors: Exporters (IT services, pharma, textiles, auto parts, metals), importers
themes.why: Tariffs, quotas and sanctions change what can be sold where and at what price.

themes.name: Government, elections and policy
themes.sectors: Depends on the policy: PSU stocks, infrastructure, consumer, sectors named in the decision
themes.why: Taxes, spending and regulation change company earnings; fiscal deficits push up interest rates.

themes.name: Posts and remarks by market-moving people
themes.sectors: Companies and sectors they talk about; overall sentiment
themes.why: Remarks by heads of government, central bankers and big-company leaders spread in minutes; public information is reflected in prices quickly.
q: "Elon Musk" post OR tweet OR "on X"
Trump says tariffs OR markets OR India
"Warren Buffett" OR "Jensen Huang" OR "Sam Altman" says
"Elon Musk" Tesla OR SpaceX OR xAI

themes.name: Crude oil, gas and commodities
themes.sectors: Oil producers and refiners, OMCs, airlines, paints, tyres, chemicals, metals
themes.why: Commodity prices change input costs and margins; India imports most of its crude.

themes.name: Rupee, dollar and foreign money flows
themes.sectors: IT services and pharma (exporters), importers, the whole market via FPI flows
themes.why: Foreign portfolio money is 'hot money' that can leave at any time; a weaker rupee raises import costs and helps exporters.
q: FPI FII outflows inflows India equities

themes.name: Regulators, courts and investigations
themes.sectors: The companies named; sometimes a whole segment (derivatives, brokers, platforms)
themes.why: Orders, penalties and rule changes alter what companies may do and can trigger exchange surveillance.

themes.name: Company results, deals and boardrooms
themes.sectors: The companies named and their peers
themes.why: Results, mergers, buybacks, management changes and governance issues change a company's value directly.

themes.name: Big tech, AI and chips
themes.sectors: IT services, semiconductors and electronics makers, data centres, telecom
themes.why: Spending plans of the world's largest tech companies drive demand for Indian IT services and global sentiment.

themes.name: China and world markets
themes.sectors: Metals, chemicals, exporters; overall risk appetite
themes.why: Integrated economies mean a problem in one region spreads; China drives global metal and commodity demand.
q: global stock markets selloff OR rally

themes.name: Credit ratings and sovereign outlook
themes.sectors: Banks and the whole market (foreign funding costs)
themes.why: Rating changes for India or large companies change borrowing costs and foreign investors' appetite.
q: Moody's OR Fitch OR S&P rating India

themes.name: Other market and business news
themes.why: Business and market stories that do not fit the themes above.
